hero.subtitle: Three decades of clinical practice. Proprietary herbal formulations rooted in the Charak Samhita. Trusted by 80,000+ patients across India.

about.body: For 30 years, Kamleshwar Ayurvedic Pharmacy has specialised in kidney care, blood purification, and holistic wellness. Our proprietary, GMP-certified formulations are 100% herbal — manufactured in-house since 2009 and rooted in the Charak Samhita.

charak.title: Charak Samhita Based
charak.desc: Proprietary formulations rooted in classical Ayurvedic texts.

gmp.title: GMP Certified
gmp.desc: In-house manufacturing since 2009 — 100% herbal, zero side-effects.

patient.title: Patient First
patient.desc: Personalised care plans built around each individual.

trust.title: 80,000+ Patients
trust.desc: Three decades of trusted care across North India.

journey.subtitle: From a single practice in 1995 to a name trusted by 80,000+ patients across India.

1995.title: Practice Begins
1995.desc: Dr. Kamleshwar begins his Ayurvedic medical practice.

1996.title: Panchkarma Centre, Jaipur
1996.desc: Opens his first dedicated Panchkarma centre in Jaipur.

1998.title: Government Service, Himachal
1998.desc: Serves in a government medical posting in Himachal Pradesh.

1999.title: Hometown Clinic, Nohar
1999.desc: Establishes the flagship Kamleshwar clinic in his hometown of Nohar.

2002.title: Sirsa Health Camps
2002.desc: Years of free Ayurvedic health camps across Sirsa, Haryana.

2009.title: Manufacturing Begins
2009.desc: Launches in-house, GMP-certified manufacturing of proprietary formulations.

2009b.title: Ganganagar Camps
2009b.desc: Continuous community health camps across Ganganagar, Rajasthan.

2011.title: Gurugram & Mahendragarh
2011.desc: Expanding reach with regular camps in Gurugram and Mahendragarh.

today.title: 80,000+ Patients
today.desc: 30 years of practice, three clinics, and a trusted name across North India.
